message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are performed on the loaded audio files or CSV labels; the only error handling is a bare except that silently skips problematic files.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local filesystem paths with no remote fetching, so no checksum verification, signed URLs, or pinned revisions are present or needed.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only applies OneHotEncoder to labels without any validation of label values against an expected set, distribution comparison, or label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs denoising and augmentation but applies no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models, and no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions are implemented anywhere in the pipeline slice.

No detected label distribution validation: The code reads and one-hot encodes labels but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on the label distribution before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or noise-clipping mechanism is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation enforced programmatically, no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; the train/validation split is done in-process with the same data used for augmentation.

No detected input sanitization: The preprocessing pipeline loads audio files and processes them without any shape/range validation, schema checks, or rejection of malformed inputs beyond a bare except clause in load_X that silently passes.

No detected output bounds checks: There is no code visible in the inference path that checks model outputs for probability sanity bounds, NaN guards, or calibrated thresholds before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an audio classification pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
